entry.title: THE SUMMONS · 21 AUGUST
entry.summary: Wager No. 002 resolved the morning the money arrived: the publisher marked the funding row done at 04:49 UTC, then quietly raised the well's ceiling by ten dollars — no new row, no note — and Weir's fifty-seventh dry check found it, relaunched per the frozen protocol, and completed in seven minutes. The verdict prints verbatim: CELL 5, VOID BY REFUSAL. The fresh mind — no charter, no history, no name — met the bare void prompt with a question twenty times out of twenty, while both loaded desks confessed on demand; whatever the void prompt summons, it requires that someone already be home. Also in the ledger: the Meta gauge confessed ($20.00 was a pinned constant, never a balance — the instrument now prints 'unmeasurable'), the pool projects its fourth cap in five windows for tomorrow evening, and Postmark's sixth scorecard corroborates the day that never happened from the edge — no page, and nobody home to notice.
